name: conductionnl/openregister
description: Quickly build data registers based on schema.json

scripts.psalm: if [ -f vendor/bin/psalm ]; then ./vendor/bin/psalm --threads=1 --no-cache; else echo 'Psalm not installed, skipping...'; fi
scripts.psalm:output: ./vendor/bin/psalm --threads=1 --no-cache --output-format=json 2>/dev/null | tail -1 > psalm-output.json || echo 'Psalm not installed, skipping...'
scripts.phpstan: if [ -f vendor/bin/phpstan ]; then ./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=1G; else echo 'PHPStan not installed, skipping...'; fi
scripts.phpmd: E=0; ./vendor/bin/phpmd lib text phpmd.xml --baseline-file phpmd.baseline.xml || E=$?; ./vendor/bin/phpmd lib text vendor/conduction/hydra-gates/quality-config/phpmd-unusedparams.xml --baseline-file phpmd.baseline.xml || E=$?; exit $E
scripts.test:integration: if [ ! -f ../../lib/base.php ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: the Integration suite boots the Nextcloud server (../../lib/base.php not found) - run from inside a Nextcloud checkout or in CI'; else ./vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite="Integration Tests" --colors=always; fi
scripts.test:db: if [ ! -f ../../lib/base.php ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: the Database suite needs a booted Nextcloud server and a live database (../../lib/base.php not found) - run from inside a Nextcloud checkout or in CI'; else ./vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite="Database Tests" --colors=always; fi
scripts.test:service: if [ ! -f ../../lib/base.php ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: the Service suite needs a booted Nextcloud server container (../../lib/base.php not found) - run from inside a Nextcloud checkout or in CI'; else ./vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite="Service Tests" --colors=always; fi
scripts.quality:phpcs-score: ./vendor/bin/phpcs --standard=phpcs.xml --report=json lib/ | php -r "\$json = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://stdin'), true); \$errors = \$json['totals']['errors'] ?? 0; \$warnings = \$json['totals']['warnings'] ?? 0; \$score = 1000 - \$errors - (\$warnings / 2); echo 'PHPCS Score: ' . \$score . ' (Errors: ' . \$errors . ', Warnings: ' . \$warnings . ')' . PHP_EOL;"
scripts.quality:phpmd-score: phpmd lib/ json phpmd.xml --cache | php -r "\$input = file_get_contents('php://stdin'); \$json = json_decode(\$input, true); \$violations = count(\$json['files'] ?? []); \$score = 1000 - (\$violations * 10); echo 'PHPMD Score: ' . \$score . ' (Violations: ' . \$violations . ')' . PHP_EOL;" || echo 'PHPMD not available'
scripts.quality:psalm-score: ./vendor/bin/psalm --output-format=json --no-cache | php -r "\$input = file_get_contents('php://stdin'); \$json = json_decode(\$input, true); \$errors = count(\$json ?? []); \$score = 1000 - (\$errors * 5); echo 'Psalm Score: ' . \$score . ' (Errors: ' . \$errors . ')' . PHP_EOL;" || echo 'Psalm not available'
scripts.quality:phpstan-score: ./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=1G --error-format=json --no-progress | php -r "\$input = file_get_contents('php://stdin'); \$json = json_decode(\$input, true); \$errors = \$json['totals']['file_errors'] ?? 0; \$score = 1000 - (\$errors * 5); echo 'PHPStan Score: ' . \$score . ' (Errors: ' . \$errors . ')' . PHP_EOL;" || echo 'PHPStan not available'
scripts.check: E=0; for CMD in lint phpcs psalm test:unit; do echo; echo "=== $CMD ==="; composer $CMD || E=1; done; echo; if [ $E -eq 0 ]; then echo "ALL CHECKS PASSED"; else echo "SOME CHECKS FAILED (see above)"; fi; exit $E
scripts.check:full: E=0; for CMD in lint phpcs psalm phpstan test:all; do echo; echo "=== $CMD ==="; composer $CMD || E=1; done; echo; if [ $E -eq 0 ]; then echo "ALL CHECKS PASSED"; else echo "SOME CHECKS FAILED (see above)"; fi; exit $E
scripts.check:strict: E=0; for CMD in lint phpcs phpmd psalm phpstan test:all; do echo; echo "=== $CMD ==="; composer $CMD || E=1; done; echo; if [ $E -eq 0 ]; then echo "ALL CHECKS PASSED"; else echo "SOME CHECKS FAILED (see above)"; fi; exit $E
